name: PD 163 was established by Ordinance No. 18037, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 9, 1983. Ordinance No. 18037 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 163 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-163.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 163 was established by Ordinance No. 18037, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 9, 1983. Ordinance No. 18037 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18037; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-163.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 163 is established on property generally located along the east line of Voss Road, north of the north line of Quail Hollow Road. The size of PD 163 is approximately 50.4 acres. (Ord. Nos. 18037; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-163.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-163.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. Development must be in accordance with the lot arrangement and street locations shown on the city plan commission-approved development plan, which is labelled Exhibit 163A. (Ord. Nos. 18037; 25508)

sections.title: Subdivision Plat
sections.text: SEC. 51P-163.105.SUBDIVISION PLAT. Prior to the issuance of any building permit, a subdivision plat, approved by the city plan commission, must be filed for record with the county clerk of the county in which the property is located. (Ord. Nos. 18037; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-163.106.USES. Development in this PD is limited to dwelling units for multiple-family uses in Tract I, and dwelling units for single-family uses in Tracts II and III. Tract II may also contain a private recreation area, as shown on the approved development plan. The provisions of Section 51-4.217(8) relating to private streets do not apply to the public access easements in Tracts I and II shown on the approved development plan. (Ord. Nos. 18037; 25508)

sections.title: Density
sections.text: SEC. 51P-163.107.DENSITY. Development in this PD is limited to no more than 144 dwelling units in Tract I, 171 dwelling units in Tract II, and 94 dwelling units in Tract III. (Ord. Nos. 18037; 25508)

sections.title: Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-163.108.HEIGHT. Maximum height for buildings and structures in Tract I is 35 feet. Maximum height for buildings and structures on top of a building or at grade level described in Section 51-4.408, “Maximum Building Height,” may project a maximum of 12 feet above the heights specified in this article. (Ord. Nos. 18037; 25508)

sections.title: Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-163.109.COVERAGE. Maximum lot coverage for Tract I is 42 percent. Maximum lot coverage for Tract II is 30 percent. Maximum lot coverage for Tract III is 45 percent. (Ord. Nos. 18037; 25508)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text: SEC. 51P-163.110.SETBACKS. Setbacks for buildings and structures in Tracts I and II must be provided as shown on the approved development plan. Setbacks for buildings and structures in Tract III must be provided in accordance with R-5 Single-Family District standards, unless otherwise indicated on the approved development plan. (Ord. Nos. 18037; 25508)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-163.111.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Division 51-7.400. (Ord. Nos. 18037; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-163.112.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Development in this PD must comply with all codes and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18037; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-163.113.PAVING.
(a)All streets, driveways, parking spaces, and maneuvering areas for parking must comply with the requirements of Division 51-4.300, “Off-street Parking and Loading Regulations.”
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 18037; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-163.114.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there is full compliance with this article and with the construction codes and all other applicable ordinances of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18037; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-163.115.ZONING MAP. PD 163 is located on Zoning Map No. AA-6. (Ord. Nos. 18037; 25508)
